text:
ashley_gtm: Starting thread for CoralSky co-sell POC. They want a 7-day private-tenant trial, SSQ answers, and a quick reserved pricing ballpark for a 2xA100 equivalent.

rahul_se: CoralSky legal sent a short SSQ and requires SSO + SCIM before sending data. They prefer Okta. Can infra share SAML/SCIM templates?

jenny_privsec: I'll own the SSQ. For pilot we can offer redwood-managed KMS (non-exportable). For prod BYOK/HSM supported. Ask them if they need SIEM forwarding during trial.

matt_ops: Ops can provision a constrained private tenant for 7 days if they sign a pilot addendum and prepay $3k baseline. We'll limit GPU count and egress and include teardown automation. Need their VPC CIDRs for peering.

oauth-bot: SAML sample:
```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://console.redwood/saml">
  <!-- ACS URL, x509 cert -->
</EntityDescriptor>
```
SCIM: POST /scim/v2/Users Authorization: Bearer <token>.

rahul_se: Perf ask: 80 rps at 300 tokens, p50 ~0.18s/token. Ballpark reserved cost: $30k-$45k/mo depending on region and exact GPU SKU. We'll run a quick perf sim if they want numbers.

ashley_gtm: They asked if we can do a no-commit short trial to speed procurement. Also want a redacted SOC2 and a controls summary.

jenny_privsec: I'll attach a redacted SOC2 and a one-page controls matrix. Data deletion SLA: default ephemeral logs 48h, metrics 30d; extended retention available with cost. Ask CoralSky whether they need audit logs to be pushed to Splunk.

matt_ops: Action items: 1) Jenny = SSQ + SOC2 pack, 2) Matt = trial tenant runbook + prepay instr + egress IPs, 3) Rahul = perf sim/runbook, 4) Ashley = collect Okta metadata.

ashley_gtm: I'll collect Okta metadata today and coordinate legal for the pilot addendum. Scheduling a 30-min enablement next Tue for SSO and telemetry. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
